overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（9 篇）、行为金融（1 篇）、国际贸易（1 篇）。方法上以模型校准、机器学习为主。来源分布：OpenAlex（6 篇）、arXiv（4 篇）、Semantic Scholar（2 篇）。

papers.title: Integrating machine learning with single-step GBLUP for enhanced genomic prediction in white spruce
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  
                    We evaluated the predictive performance of machine learning-augmented single- and multi-trait single-step genomic best linear prediction (ssGBLUP) models for 30 complex traits spanning productivity, chemical defense, and climate adaptability in white spruce (
                    Picea glauca
                    ) from Alberta, Canada, genotyped at 211,061 SNPs. We extend a novel integration of the ssGBLUP with non-linear kernels for forest tree improvement. Using the conventional ssGBLUP model with VanRaden’s linear genomic relationship matrix as baseline, we compared two non-linear extensions: an averaged Gaussian kernel (GK) with trait-specific bandwidths and an arc-cosine kernel (AK) with 1–20 layers (depth). To relate prediction gains to genetic architecture, we also fitted an extended GBLUP model explicitly including additive, dominance, and epistatic (additive × additive and additive × dominance) effects. Additive effects predominated in 21 traits, dominance contributed > 50% of variance in several chemical-defense traits, and epistasis explained ~ 25% in key physiological traits. Predictive performance varied by kernel type and trait architecture. AK achieved the highest accuracy in 29 traits, improving prediction by up to 27% (predictive differences up to ~ 0.10), particularly for traits with more complex genetic architectures. GK yielded modest gains (< 7%; predictive differences < 0.03), while linear G kernel remained competitive for core productivity traits. In multi-trait models, non-linear kernels performed similar to the linear alternatives. Notably, low-heritability traits such as drought resistance improved from 0.446-0.517 to 0.461-0.547 accuracy with multi-trait integration. These findings suggest that matching kernel complexity to genetic architecture may enhance genomic prediction and highlight the potential of non-linear kernels, particularly AK, in forest tree breeding.

【行为金融】摘要

我们评估了基于机器学习的单性状和多性状单步基因组最佳线性预测（ssGBLUP）模型在预测加拿大阿尔伯塔省白云杉（Picea glauca）30个复杂性状方面的表现。这些性状涵盖了生产力、化学防御能力和气候适应性，相关基因型数据基于211,061个单核苷酸多态性（SNP）进行构建。我们创新性地将ssGBLUP方法与非线性核函数结合，用于森林树木的改良。以传统的ssGBLUP模型（采用VanRaden线性基因组关系矩阵）作为基准，我们比较了两种非线性核函数的扩展方案：一种是具有性状特异性带宽的平均高斯核（GK），另一种是具有1–20层结构的弧余弦核（AK）。为将预测精度提升与遗传结构联系起来，我们还构建了一个扩展的GBLUP模型，该模型明确考虑了加性效应、显性效应以及上位性效应（加性×加性和加性×显性）。在21个性状中，加性效应占主导地位；在多个化学防御性状中，显性效应贡献了超过50%的方差；而在关键生理性状中，上位性效应解释了约25%的变异。预测精度因核函数类型和性状遗传结构的不同而有所差异。其中，弧余弦核在29个性状中的预测精度最高，准确率提升了多达27%（预测差异最大约...。研究方法：机器学习。

papers.title: Cross-Sector Policies for Achieving Equitable Obesity Prevention and Food Security: A Review of Real-World Actions
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  
                    Purpose of Review
                    This narrative review examines how government sectors beyond health contribute to the dual goals of equitable obesity prevention and food security through structural, cross‑sector policies. It aimed to synthesise real‑world evidence on the design, implementation and diet‑related impacts of policies across social, education, economic, trade and agricultural, and legal domains.
                  
                  
                    Recent Findings
                    Emerging insights highlight the need for further evaluation of how income supports contribute to diet-related health; the expansion of school meal programs given their multiple co-benefits; the feasibility and impacts of adopting health-promoting taxes that generate public revenue for equity-focused initiatives; how agricultural supports can be repurposed to improve local and equitable food access; and the use of legal instruments to hold food industries accountable and advance public health interests.
                  
                  
                    Summary
                    Coordinated, equitable progress on obesity prevention and food security will require enhanced policy coherence, effective accountability mechanisms, better data on diet and equity outcomes for cross-sector policies, and political commitment to overcome siloed and often unbalanced decision-making processes.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】**摘要**

**综述目的**  
本叙述性综述探讨了除卫生部门之外的其他政府部门如何通过结构性、跨部门政策为实现公平的肥胖预防和粮食安全这一双重目标做出贡献。研究旨在综合来自社会、教育、经济、贸易、农业及法律领域的政策设计、实施及其对饮食影响的实际证据。

**最新研究结果**  
最新研究结果表明：需要进一步评估收入支持措施对饮食健康的影响；鉴于学校餐食计划的多重益处，应扩大其覆盖范围；探讨征收促进健康的税收以增加公共收入、进而支持公平性相关举措的可行性和效果；思考如何重新利用农业支持措施来改善当地民众的粮食获取状况并促进公平分配；同时，还需研究如何运用法律手段促使食品行业承担责任、维护公共健康利益。

**结论**  
要在肥胖预防和粮食安全方面取得协调、公平的进展，需要加强政策间的协同性，建立有效的问责机制，收集更准确的关于饮食状况及政策公平性影响的数据，并争取政治层面的支持，以克服那些孤立运作且往往失衡的决策流程。。

papers.title: Grounded Event Extraction from SEC 8-K Filings with a Fine-Grained Taxonomy
papers.abstract: Form 8-K filings are the primary channel through which U.S. public companies disclose material events, but the SEC item codes attached to them are coarse: a single item spans routine administrative changes and chief executive departures, and many of the most market-moving disclosures fall into a catch-all item. Large language models make fine-grained labelling feasible at corpus scale, but only if the labels can be traced to the source text and shown to be reliable. We present a two-stage system that tags 8-K disclosures against a three-tier taxonomy of 119 event types. The first stage constrains output to valid taxonomy entries and anchors every tag to a verbatim quote via fuzzy n-gram validation; the second re-grades each cited quote against the category definition to produce a quality score. Applying the system to 292,984 filings from 2022 to 2026 yields 601,088 grounded event tags, which we release. Over 5,125 stratified tags, an LLM judge finds precision rises monotonically with the quality score, from 12% to 96%, while unsupported tags fall from 8% to near zero. Ablation shows the score is calibrated only when assigned in a dedicated second pass. An event study on unsigned abnormal returns confirms, without any language model, that the taxonomy separates economically distinct events sharing an item code.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】8-K文件是美国上市公司披露重大事件的主要渠道，但附在这些文件上的SEC项目代码较为笼统：一个项目可能涵盖了常规的行政变更和首席执行官的离职等不同事件，而许多对市场影响较大的披露内容则被归入同一个通用项目类别中。大型语言模型能够在大规模语料库中实现细粒度的事件分类，但这前提是这些分类标签能够追溯到原始文本，并且其可靠性得到验证。我们提出了一种两阶段系统，该系统根据包含119种事件类型的分类体系对8-K文件中的披露内容进行标注。第一阶段通过模糊n-gram验证确保标注结果符合有效的分类标准，并将每个标签与原文中的具体引文关联起来；第二阶段则根据事件类别的定义重新评估这些引文的准确性，从而生成一个质量评分。将该系统应用于2022年至2026年的292,984份文件后，共获得了601,088个基于实际文本的事件标签，这些标签已被公开发布。在5,125个经过分层处理的标签样本中，语言模型评估显示：随着评分的提高，标注的精确度从12%提升到了96%；而那些缺乏依据的标签的精确度则从8%下降到了接近零。实验结果表明，只有在进行第二次专门标注时，评分系统才能达到最佳效果。一项针对未签署异常回报...。研究方法：事件研究、模型校准、大语言模型。

papers.title: Finite-Population Inference for Heterogeneity in Many-Group Synthetic Difference-in-Differences
papers.abstract: Synthetic difference-in-differences is widely used to estimate treatment effects for many treated groups against a common donor pool. When the same donors are reused across groups, the group-specific estimates are cross-sectionally dependent, and plug-in second moments overstate effect heterogeneity. We develop finite-population inference for heterogeneity in many-group synthetic difference-in-differences: the projection of realized group effects on observed group covariates, the projected group-effect curve, the between-group variance, and the explained share. The theory combines a modular first-stage representation, a joint covariance kernel for donor sharing and block dependence, analytic and leave-out corrections for second moments, and calibrated omnibus and directed tests under explicit exchangeability or fit-matching conditions. In an American Community Survey application to the Affordable Care Act Medicaid expansion, whose estimand is the incremental effect of expansion status, pre-expansion uninsured rates explain much of the state-level effect variation on the percentage-point scale, household split-samples validate the decomposition, and donor sharing materially increases the standard error for the average effect. In a county-level Clean Air Act application, groupwise estimates are noisy, but a pre-specified projection on baseline fine-particulate pollution reveals a sign-stable directed component under state and division block covariance; placebo analyses attribute part of the raw gradient to regional convergence.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】合成差异-差异（synthetic difference-in-differences）方法被广泛用于估计多个受处理组相对于共同捐赠者池的处理效应。当相同的捐赠者在不同组中被重复使用时，各组的估计结果存在横截面依赖性，而通过插值法计算的第二矩会高估效应的异质性。我们提出了针对多组合成差异-差异模型中效应异质性的有限样本推断方法，包括将实际观测到的组效应投影到组协变量上、构建预测的组效应曲线、计算组间方差以及解释效应占比等。该方法结合了模块化的第一阶段处理方式、用于描述捐赠者共享和组间依赖性的联合协方差核函数、针对第二矩的分析性修正及剔除法、以及在明确的可交换性或匹配条件下进行的综合检验与定向检验。以美国社区调查（American Community Survey）中关于《平价医疗法案》（Affordable Care Act）医疗补助扩展政策的应用为例，该政策的估计目标是政策实施前后的效应差异；结果显示，政策实施前的未参保率在州层面解释了大部分效应变化（以百分点为单位），家庭分层样本验证了这种效应分解的合理性；同时，捐赠者共享现象显著增加了平均效应的标准误差。在另一项关于《清洁空...。研究方法：双重差分、横截面分析、模型校准、调查数据。

papers.title: The Impact of Sustainable Finance on Petroleum Trade and Transportation: Evidence from the Global Energy Transition
papers.venue: International Journal of Energy Economics and Policy
papers.abstract: This study examines the impact of sustainable finance on petroleum trade and transportation within the context of the global energy transition, employing a quantitative-dominant mixed-method empirical design. Primary data were collected through structured questionnaires (n = 86) and complemented with secondary data from industry reports and academic literature. Descriptive and inferential statistical techniques, including correlation and regression analysis, were used to test the study hypotheses. The results indicate that sustainable finance has a significant negative effect on access to capital (β = -0.50, p < 0.001), reflecting the tightening of ESG-based financing conditions, which reduce capital availability and increase the cost of capital in carbon-intensive sectors. Conversely, sustainable finance exerts significant positive effects on trade flows (β = 0.42, p < 0.01), innovation (β = 0.60, p < 0.001), and alignment challenges (β = 0.47, p < 0.001). These findings highlight the dual role of sustainable finance as both a constraint and a driver of transformation in carbon-intensive sectors.
papers.summary_zh: 【国际贸易】本研究在全球能源转型的背景下，采用以定量分析为主的混合方法实证设计，探讨了可持续金融对石油贸易和运输的影响。主要数据通过结构化问卷（n = 86）收集，并结合了行业报告和学术文献中的二手数据。研究运用描述性和推断性统计技术（包括相关分析和回归分析）来验证假设。结果表明，可持续金融对资本获取具有显著的负面影响（β = -0.50，p < 0.001），这反映了基于环境、社会和治理（ESG）标准的融资条件的收紧，导致资本供应减少，碳密集型行业的资本成本上升。另一方面，可持续金融对贸易流量（β = 0.42，p < 0.01）、创新（β = 0.60，p < 0.001）以及企业转型过程中的协调问题（β = 0.47，p < 0.001）具有显著的积极影响。这些发现凸显了可持续金融在碳密集型行业中的双重作用：它既是转型的制约因素，也是推动转型的动力。。研究方法：回归分析。

papers.title: Dynamic Relationships between Foreign Direct Investment Inflows, Financial Development, Institutional Quality, and Economic Growth: Empirical Evidence from Burundi
papers.abstract: This article analyses the dynamic interdependencies between foreign direct investment inflows, financial development, institutional quality, and economic growth in Burundi over the period 1972–2024. Drawing on the poverty vicious circle theory, new institutional economics, and the finance-growth literature, we estimate six structural VAR models with Granger causality tests, impulse response functions, and variance decompositions. Three robust results emerge. First, financial development does not stimulate economic growth according to the classical supply-side pattern of financial services. A one-standard-deviation shock to private-sector credit increases inflation by 2.5 to 2.9 percentage points over a two-year horizon across all specifications and explains 14.5 percent of the variance in ten-year inflation, while reducing economic growth by 1.0 to 1.3 percentage points. Second, economic growth reduces inflation by about 2.8 percentage points over two years and accounts for 15.5 percent of its long-term variance, confirming a dominant agricultural supply effect rather than demand-pull inflation. But after the first two years, inflation continues its upward trend until it becomes stable. Third, institutional quality acts selectively: Granger tests show that only overall institutional quality and executive corruption cause financial development, while political corruption, the rule of law, and liberal democracy have no significant effect. Response functions indicate that an increase in executive corruption reduces financial depth by percentage points over two years, and variance decomposition attributes 8.7 percent of the variance in financial development to executive corruption alone, compared to less than 3 percent for the other institutional dimensions. Foreign direct investment remains causally inert in all models and never explains more than 4 percent of the macroeconomic variance. The results highlight a specific Burundian chain: constraints on executive predation allow for modest financial deepening, which is primarily transmitted to prices rather than productive investment, while growth itself is determined by exogenous agricultural supply shocks. Breaking Nurkse’s vicious cycle therefore requires targeted institutional reforms focused on the executive rather than generic governance reforms.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】本文分析了1972年至2024年间布隆迪外国直接投资流入、金融发展、制度质量与经济增长之间的动态相互关系。基于贫困恶性循环理论、新制度经济学以及金融发展与经济增长的相关文献，我们构建了六个结构向量自回归（VAR）模型，并进行了格兰杰因果关系检验、脉冲响应函数分析及方差分解。研究得出了三个主要结论：  

首先，金融发展并未按照传统的金融服务供给侧机制促进经济增长。在所有模型设定中，私营部门信贷遭受一个标准差幅度的冲击会导致两年内通货膨胀率上升2.5%至2.9%，同时抑制经济增长1.0%至1.3%；这一冲击解释了十年通货膨胀波动的14.5%。  

其次，经济增长在两年内能够降低通货膨胀率约2.8%，并解释了其长期波动的15.5%，这表明通货膨胀主要受农业供给因素驱动而非需求拉动。然而，在最初两年之后，通货膨胀率仍会继续上升直至趋于稳定。  

第三，制度质量对经济增长具有选择性影响：格兰杰检验显示，仅有整体制度质量和行政腐败对金融发展具有显著促进作用，而政治腐败、法治水平及自由民主制度则无明显影响。脉冲响应函数表明，行政腐败的增加会削弱金融体系的深度；方差分解结果显示，行政腐败单...。研究方法：向量自回归。

papers.title: Double-Hurdle Approach to Understanding Household Willingness to Pay for Public Flood Mitigation Infrastructure in Vietnam
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  The understanding of household willingness to pay for improving the public drainage infrastructure remains limited, especially in the low- and middle-income classes. To advance this literature, we construct a comprehensive behavioral framework that integrates the protection motivation theory, collective action theory, and social exchange theory to explain household financial engagement in urban flood mitigation. The double hurdle model is applied to disentangle the household decision-making process into two stages, namely, participation and payment level, using data from 627 households in Nghe An Province, Vietnam. Results reveal that risk perception, education, age, and size of a household significantly relate to stronger willingness to participate and stronger willingness to pay for the improvement of the public drainage infrastructure, while the monthly income and trust in government policies of a household exert unexpected negative effects in both stages. Prior flood damage is found to significantly increase payment amounts but not the participation likelihood. Our double hurdle approach is superior to the Tobit model by revealing the distinct behavioral mechanisms of the low- to middle-income households underlying their contributions to the shared infrastructure.
papers.summary_zh:
【劳动经济学】摘要  
目前，对于家庭在改善公共排水基础设施方面愿意支付的意愿仍缺乏足够的了解，尤其是在低收入和中等收入群体中。为了推进相关研究，我们构建了一个综合的行为框架，该框架融合了保护动机理论、集体行动理论和社会交换理论，以解释家庭在城市防洪工作中的财务投入行为。我们采用双重门槛模型（double hurdle model）将家庭决策过程划分为两个阶段：参与决策和支付意愿的确定，并以越南义安省（Nghe An Province）627户家庭的数据作为分析依据。研究结果表明，风险感知、教育水平、家庭年龄以及家庭规模与家庭更强的参与意愿和支付意愿显著相关；然而，家庭的月收入以及对政府政策的信任却在两个阶段都产生了意想不到的负面影响。此外，以往的洪水灾害经历会显著增加家庭的支付金额，但并不会提高其参与意愿。与Tobit模型相比，我们的双重门槛模型更能揭示低收入至中等收入家庭在为公共基础设施做出贡献时的不同行为机制。。

papers.title: Time-Driven Activity-Based Costing for Selling Price Determination: Evidence from Sambal Berkah Chips MSMEs in Sibolga, Indonesia
papers.abstract: This research is conducted to examine the calculation of production costs and the application of the Time-Driven Activity-Based Costing (TDABC) method in setting the selling price of Berkah Sambal Chips MSME located in Sibolga City, Indonesia. The study adopts a qualitative approach with a case study design. Data were obtained through interviews, direct observations, and documentation. The results show that the traditional costing approach generates a total daily production cost of IDR 2,689,298.00, with a unit production cost of IDR 3,362.00 per package. In contrast, the TDABC method generated a total production cost of IDR 2,615,198.00 per day, with a cost of production of IDR 3,269.00 per package. The reduction in production costs occurred because TDABC allocates costs based on effective working time, resulting in a more accurate allocation of production costs. Applying a 30% markup, the TDABC method produced a selling price of IDR 4,717.00 per package. However, the enterprise maintained a selling price of IDR 5,000.00 per package to achieve a higher profit margin. These results indicate that the Time-Driven Activity-Based Costing (TDABC) method improves cost efficiency and offers a more precise foundation for setting selling prices in Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs).
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究旨在探讨生产成本的计算方法，以及时间驱动型作业成本法（Time-Driven Activity-Based Costing, TDABC）在印度尼西亚西博尔加市Berkah Sambal Chips微型、小型和中型企业（MSME）定价中的应用。研究采用定性方法，并采用案例研究设计。数据通过访谈、直接观察和文献资料收集获得。研究结果表明，传统成本核算方法导致的每日总生产成本为2,689,298.00印尼盾，每包产品的单位成本为3,362.00印尼盾；而TDABC方法计算的每日总生产成本为2,615,198.00印尼盾，每包产品的单位成本为3,269.00印尼盾。生产成本降低的原因是TDABC根据实际工作时间来分配成本，从而实现了更准确的成本核算。在加收30%的利润空间后，TDABC方法得出的每包产品售价为4,717.00印尼盾；但该企业仍维持每包5,000.00印尼盾的售价，以获得更高的利润率。这些结果表明，时间驱动型作业成本法（TDABC）能够提升成本效率，并为微型、小型和中型企业的定价提供更精确的依据。。

papers.title: STRATEGIES TO ENHANCE THE ORGANIZATIONAL AND ECONOMIC FRAMEWORKS FOR THE ADVANCEMENT OF THE TOURIST AND HOTEL BUSINESS
papers.abstract: The purpose of the work was to assess the peculiarities of the functioning of tourism and hotel business in this area, as well as to draw conclusions about the possibilities for further improvement. The main research methods were analysis, forecasting and abstraction. The dynamics of the development of tourism services in Kazakhstan was investigated and key percentage changes was highlighted, in particular, the real growth in the volume of services, taking into account inflation, by 171%, which corresponds to an average annual increase of 6.4%, as well as fluctuations in 2020–2022 due to the COVID-19 pandemic and migration processes. It was highlighted that domestic tourism is developing faster than external tourism, since the number of residents served increased by 565%, while non-residents by 255%. It was also found that the city of Almaty concentrates the largest share of the country’s tourist activity (more than 22% of sleep days, 30.7% of the volume of services and 24.7% of visitors), while the Zhetysu region occupies medium positions with a share of about 4–5% in terms of basic indicators. It was highlighted that the modernization of tourism infrastructure, the development of digital solutions, the expansion of types of tourist services, the priority of ecological tourism. The obtained results can be used for public authorities, regional managers, representatives of the tourism and hotel business, as well as investors to justify management decisions, plan infrastructure development and improve the efficiency of the region’s tourism industry.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究的目的是评估该地区旅游业和酒店业的运作特点，并就进一步改进的可能性提出结论。主要研究方法包括分析、预测和归纳。研究考察了哈萨克斯坦旅游服务的发展动态，重点关注了关键百分比变化：考虑到通货膨胀因素，服务总量的实际增长率为171%，相当于年均增长6.4%；同时分析了2020年至2022年间因新冠疫情和人口迁移导致的波动。研究发现，国内旅游业的发展速度超过了国外旅游业——本地居民接待量增长了565%，而非本地居民接待量增长了255%。阿尔马蒂市在该国旅游业中占据主导地位，其旅游活动占比超过22%（包括住宿天数、服务总量和游客数量）；而杰特苏地区在各项基本指标上的占比约为4-5%，处于中等水平。研究建议加强旅游基础设施的现代化建设、发展数字化解决方案、拓展旅游服务类型，并优先发展生态旅游。这些研究结果可为政府机构、地区管理者、旅游业和酒店业从业者以及投资者提供决策依据，有助于他们制定合理的基础设施发展规划，提升该地区旅游业的运营效率。。

papers.title: Analisis Kebijakan Pemberian Pesangon sebagai Bentuk Kompensasi Pasca-Kerja dan Dampaknya terhadap Keharmonisan Hubungan Industrial di Era Omnibus Law
papers.abstract: This study aims to systematically analyze the implementation of severance pay policy as a manifestation of post-employment compensation and its profound impact on the harmony of industrial relations within the regulatory framework of the Omnibus Law in Indonesia. Utilizing a Systematic Literature Review (SLR) methodology aligned with the PRISMA framework, this research comprehensively synthesizes data from 25 selected academic articles encompassing human resource management, employment law, and organizational behavior. The findings reveal that the paradigm shift from the previous labor regulations to the Omnibus Law framework has fundamentally altered the calculation mechanisms and statutory floors for severance pay. While these legislative adjustments are strategically designed to enhance organizational agility and mitigate financial distress for corporations, they have engendered substantial apprehension among the workforce regarding the degradation of normative rights. Consequently, this policy transformation presents a critical challenge to sustaining industrial harmony, frequently precipitating labor disputes, diminishing employee morale, and intensifying bipartite conflicts. This study recommends that human resource practitioners proactively develop transparent communication strategies and design complementary post-employment benefit architectures to restore distributive justice. Furthermore, policymakers are urged to institute robust oversight mechanisms to ensure equitable implementation and safeguard worker welfare without compromising long-term business sustainability.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究旨在系统分析离职补偿政策（作为离职后薪酬的一种形式）的实施方式，以及该政策在印度尼西亚《综合法》监管框架下对劳资关系和谐的深远影响。研究采用与PRISMA框架相一致的系统性文献回顾（Systematic Literature Review, SLR）方法，综合了25篇涵盖人力资源管理、劳动法和组织行为领域的学术文章的数据。研究结果表明，从以往的劳动法规向《综合法》框架的转变从根本上改变了离职补偿的计算机制和法定最低标准。尽管这些立法调整旨在提升企业的灵活性并缓解其财务压力，但它们引发了员工对自身权益受损的担忧。因此，这种政策变革对维护劳资关系和谐构成了严峻挑战，常常导致劳资纠纷、员工士气下降以及双方冲突加剧。研究建议人力资源从业者积极制定透明的沟通策略，并设计完善的离职后福利体系以恢复分配公平性。同时，政策制定者应建立有效的监督机制，确保政策的公平实施，并在保障劳动者福利的同时不影响企业的长期可持续发展。。

papers.title: Sufficientarian Grading Rules and Rankings: Characterizations and Implementation
papers.abstract: Sufficientarian grading rules are defined using a finite family of sufficientarian judgements on individual capability assignments as embodied in a sufficientarian binary grading function (BGF). Both sufficientarian grading rules and the sufficientarian total preorders on capability-type assignments they induce are characterized. Moreover, several further total preorders based upon sufficiency-gap information provided by a sufficientarian grading rule are explicitly defined and some of them are also characterized. It is also shown that there exists a class of inclusive, unanimity-respecting and suitably strategy-proof protocols (including simple majority when the number of agents is odd) which can be deployed in order to select one specific sufficientarian grading rule.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】充分性评分规则是通过一组有限的、关于个体能力分配的充分性判断来定义的，这些判断被具体化为一个充分性二元评分函数（BGF）。本文对这类评分规则及其所诱导的能力类型分配的充分性全序关系进行了分析。此外，还明确定义了几种基于充分性评分规则所提供的“充分性差距”信息的进一步全序关系，并对其中一些关系进行了进一步研究。研究还表明，存在一类具有包容性、尊重全体一致性的协议（当代理人数量为奇数时也包括简单多数投票机制），这些协议可以用来选择特定的充分性评分规则。。

papers.title: Robustness in Sequential Decision Making under Evolving Uncertainty: Evidence from High-Frequency Market Making
papers.abstract: We study sequential decision making under evolving uncertainty in high-frequency financial markets, where changing market dynamics continually challenge static decision policies. We show that robustness has two economically meaningful dimensions: uncertainty tolerance, which determines how much uncertainty the decision maker allows, and action robustness, which governs how conservatively decisions respond. Robustness is not merely protection against model misspecification, but a state-dependent mechanism that reshapes sequential decision behaviors. Simulation and empirical evidence show that action robustness has a substantially larger impact than uncertainty tolerance. Moreover, excessive robustness may reduce profitability in illiquid markets by limiting execution opportunities.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了在高频金融市场中，面对不断变化的不确定性时如何进行序贯决策。市场动态的持续变化不断对静态决策策略构成挑战。研究发现，决策的鲁棒性具有两个具有经济意义的维度：一是不确定性容忍度，即决策者能够接受多大的不确定性；二是行为鲁棒性，即决策在面对不确定性时的保守程度。鲁棒性不仅仅是对模型误设的防护机制，而是一种依赖于市场状态的机制，它能够重塑决策者的序贯决策行为。仿真分析和实证证据表明，行为鲁棒性的影响远大于不确定性容忍度。此外，在流动性较差的市场中，过度的鲁棒性可能会通过限制交易机会而降低盈利能力。。研究方法：数值模拟。
